name: mercado_libre-ecommerce-channels-mcp
description: Mercado Libre (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, list_orders. Eve

platform_mcp_mercado_libre_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_mercado_libre_client_id.description: App ID of your application (developers.mercadolibre.com > My applications); sent as client_id in the token request body.

platform_mcp_mercado_libre_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_mercado_libre_client_secret.description: Secret Key of the same application; sent as client_secret in the token request body.

platform_mcp_mercado_libre_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_mercado_libre_refresh_token.description: Refresh token (TG-...) from a one-time authorization-code consent by the seller's ADMIN account (valid 6 months). It is SINGLE-USE: every refresh returns a new access token (6 h) and a new refresh token, and only the last one issued is accepted. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/<platform>.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start. Without the state directory, a restart after the first refresh needs a fresh refresh token.

platform_mcp_mercado_libre_seller_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_SELLER_ID
platform_mcp_mercado_libre_seller_id.description: Numeric Mercado Libre user id of the seller (the `id` returned by GET /users/me); used as the seller filter of the order search.

platform_mcp_mercado_libre_env.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_ENV
platform_mcp_mercado_libre_env.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = production host with test accounts or test keys. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

platform_mcp_mercado_libre_base_url.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_BASE_URL
platform_mcp_mercado_libre_base_url.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /users/me returns the authorised user {id, nickname, site_id, country_id, ...}; its id is the seller_id config value.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: PUT /items/{item_id} {title, price, available_quantity} with only the given fields (Sync and modify listings). The title can only change while sold_quantity = 0; `description` has its own endpoint (/items/{id}/description) and is not mapped. The listing guide points to the Prices API for price management. Returns the item; `status` is active|paused|closed|under_review...

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: PUT /items/{item_id} {status: paused} takes the listing off sale and out of view, reversible with status active. `closed` (final, can only be relisted) and the deleted flag are not used.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: PUT /items/{item_id} {available_quantity} sets stock; 0 auto-pauses the item (out_of_stock) on MLB, MLA, MLM, MLC, MPE and MLV, and a positive value reactivates it. `listing_id` (item id, e.g. MLA1136716168) is required; items are not addressed by SKU. Variation stock is per variation (not mapped).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GET /orders/search?seller={seller_id}&order.status(confirmed|payment_required|payment_in_process|partially_paid|paid|cancelled...; comma-separated)&order.date_created.from(ISO-8601, hour precision)&sort=date_desc&offset&limit (the documented page size is 50). Returns {results[{id, status, total_amount, currency_id, date_created, shipping{id}}], paging{total, offset, limit}}.
